metadata: TerrainSurface {normal:[i8;3],height:u8}: 4 bytes/pixel in source map + 4 bytes/pixel in retained terrain cache.

normal_convention.curved_summit: Rotate horizontal normal by authored elliptical rim outward direction.

cache_guards: Retained terrain is copied before any prop Plane overwrites the scratch.
Visible native ground-hook sprite metadata wins over cached terrain.
HOLE and outside-map pixels receive no terrain surface.
Prop breakage refreshes the same bounded native cache region.
Geometry setters invalidate the zone-owned cache.
lighting_changes: Old moving weather and radial occlusion skipped when surface_lighting=true.
Actor readability floor .58/.61/.72 in surface mode; legacy path unchanged.
Old Cinder actor edge-rim disabled only in surface mode.
surface_shadows module registered and point_visibility wrapper exported.
validation: Root reported all 172 tests passing before the final diagnostic-only coverage helper. No Cargo builds run by this agent.

lighting_source_separation.contact_buffer: One u8/pixel, retaining source-independent attached contact and AO. Legacy dark remains unchanged for diagnostic/reference rendering.
lighting_source_separation.cold_form_buffer: One u8/pixel, retaining matte geometric fill multiplier without cached nearest-source facing/rim.
lighting_source_separation.physical_night: Glasswater, Cinder, Summit use contact-only darkness and cold fill + real broad lava-bank reception. Cached point-facing/rims and old actor proxy cast shadows are excluded.
lighting_source_separation.bloomwild: Legitimate fixed-sun cast/contact lighting retained; directional normal term is owned by root.
lighting_source_separation.incremental_refresh: Prop-breakage crop restores contact from canonical scenery, rebuilds matte form and geometry in the same bounded region.
lighting_source_separation.legacy: Existing Field.light, Field.dark and proxy behavior preserved when surface_lighting=false.
lighting_source_separation.validation: Diff whitespace check passed. Root owns the next build/test run.
